title: Fox Folk Origin
description: My Fox folk origin that I have made
body:
**Fox Folk**
Impact: 🔴 🔴 🔴 
`A creature born deep within the woods of the harsh taiga this creature will pave its own way through the world despite its small size.`

 🟢 Leap!
 You can bound and leap through the woods and caves as if it were your playground to move as you please.
 
 ﻿🟢﻿ Agile Body
 You take no fall damage due to the way your agile body moves through the air to guide your descent.
 
 🟡 Fox sized
 You are smaller than a player but taller than a slab, and have increased jump height, and momentum.
 
 🟡 Defenseless or Not...
 Mobs will not attack you unprovoked unless they are more brutish creatures from deep below. However this has greatly weakened you in combat against other players.
 
 🟢 Scavenger
 Being able to dig allows you to be able to dig up things while crouching from blocks like podzol and soul sand (in their respective biomes) you can scavenge through it and gain sweet berries and *other things* over time
 -Taiga (Podzol)
 -Floral Biomes (Grass Blocks)
 -Nether Biomes (Soul sand/soil)
 -Desert Biomes (Sand)
 
 🟢 Mystic Satchel
 You carry a magical satchel which gifted by a kitsune that won't drop items on death inside of this satchel.
 -Upon origin change all items in satchel will be dropped on the ground
 
 🟢 Berries and Meats
 Fill you up much more than 
 normal people
 
 🟡 Desperate Snack
 An ability where you consume most food reserves in a desperate attempt to stay alive in a dire situation
 -Activate key to reduce hunger and saturation by 10 points in return giving you regeneration for a few seconds to escape.
 
 🔴 Insatiable Hunger
 You lose hunger 3x as fast
 
 🔴 Small Body 
 You only have 6 hearts**
